_guide: Equipment, clothing and traits. Each one is just a name and a description, plus tags.
To add one: copy an entry, give it a new id (lowercase, dashes, never reused), change the words.
kind: "equipment", "clothing" or "trait". Crafting makes a random equipment or clothing item; traits are picked on the Crew page.
kind "ship": equipment for the ship itself, crafted for 4 Knowledge points. Its tags unlock Stay here activities (activities.json, "shipTags") and crew moments.
desc: one or two sentences that help the player imagine it. No numbers or stats.
tags: short words that events and lines can look for, like warm, light, shiny, loud, brave, keepsake.
Reuse tags that already exist where you can, so old events notice new items.

items.name: patched scarf
items.desc: Knitted by someone who loved you, mended by someone who didn't know how.

items.name: yellow raincoat
items.desc: Bright enough to find you in any storm. The pockets are full of old wrappers.

items.name: mirrored visor
items.desc: Everyone you talk to sees themselves in it, which makes some of them nervous.

items.name: moss-green boots
items.desc: Soft soles that never squeak. Small plants keep trying to grow on them.

items.name: old flight jacket
items.desc: Cracked leather and a patch from a squadron nobody remembers. It still smells faintly of engine oil.

items.name: sweater with stars on it
items.desc: Hand-knitted. The constellations are wrong, but they're wrong in a very confident way.

items.name: floppy bucket hat
items.desc: Keeps the sun off and the dignity low. Has a small pin shaped like a mushroom.

items.name: grease-stained overalls
items.desc: More pockets than anyone could need. One of them rattles and nobody knows why.

items.name: silver travel cloak
items.desc: It ripples even when there's no wind, and catches starlight like water.

items.name: mismatched mittens
items.desc: One red, one blue. The other two are out there somewhere, also mismatched.

items.name: lab coat with a coffee stain
items.desc: The stain is shaped like a small continent. It has been named.

items.name: see-through poncho
items.desc: Folds into a pouch the size of an apple. Unfolding it takes ten minutes and a lot of patience.

items.name: beaded necklace
items.desc: Every bead is from a different world. A few of them are probably just candy.

items.name: thick brass goggles
items.desc: Make everything look slightly orange and slightly more dramatic.

items.name: magnetic spacer boots
items.desc: Clunk. Clunk. Clunk. You can always hear them coming down the corridor.

items.name: flower crown
items.desc: Woven from flowers of three different planets. They keep blooming, somehow.

items.name: striped night cap
items.desc: Worn at all hours, not only at night. There's a little bell on the end.

items.name: patched diving suit
items.desc: Built for oceans on worlds where the water is something else entirely.

items.name: billowy poet's shirt
items.desc: Far too dramatic for the ship. Perfect for standing on cliffs.

items.name: reflective safety vest
items.desc: Bright orange with silver stripes. Nobody has ever been run over while wearing it.

items.name: brass lantern
items.desc: Older than the ship. It burns with a small, steady, honey-coloured flame.

items.name: pocket telescope
items.desc: Folds down to the size of a pencil. The lens has one tiny scratch shaped like a bird.

items.name: sketchbook
items.desc: Half full of planets you've seen and half full of ones you made up.

items.name: dented thermos
items.desc: Keeps tea hot for exactly as long as a study session.

items.name: field journal
items.desc: Water-stained, with pressed leaves between the pages and a pencil tied to the spine.

items.name: harmonica
items.desc: Knows three songs. Plays them all slightly too slowly.

items.name: geologist's hammer
items.desc: Small, sharp and very good at finding out what's inside things.

items.name: set of sample jars
items.desc: Twelve little glass jars in a padded case. Two of them are full of something that hums.

items.name: compass that points somewhere
items.desc: It doesn't point north. It points somewhere, and it's very sure about it.

items.name: folding kite
items.desc: Bright paper and a spool of silver string. Flies best in thin air.

items.name: instant camera
items.desc: Spits out a little square photo with a whirr. The colours always come out a bit too warm.

items.name: chunky multitool
items.desc: Has a blade, pliers, three screwdrivers and one tool nobody has identified.

items.name: bundle of glow sticks
items.desc: Crack one and the dark turns green, pink or blue. Mostly green.

items.name: hand-crank radio
items.desc: Picks up music from nowhere in particular. Turn the crank and it hums along.

items.name: checkered picnic blanket
items.desc: Red and white squares, a few crumbs that might be older than you.

items.name: pouch of seeds
items.desc: Seeds from every garden world so far, each wrapped in paper with a careful label.

items.name: long brass spyglass
items.desc: Pulls out to the length of an arm. Makes everyone holding it look like a pirate.

items.name: coil of climbing rope
items.desc: Blue and frayed at one end. Has seen a lot of cliffs and a couple of trees.

items.name: tiny music box
items.desc: Plays seven notes, then stops, as if it's waiting for an answer.

items.name: folding camp stove
items.desc: Makes one pot of soup at a time and a lot of very satisfying clicking noises.

items.name: curious
items.desc: Has never once walked past a strange rock without turning it over.

items.name: nervous
items.desc: Jumps at small noises, but always comes back to see what made them.

items.name: gentle
items.desc: Talks to plants, animals and machines in the same soft voice.

items.name: grumpy
items.desc: Complains about every planet, then writes the longest log entries about them.

items.name: brave
items.desc: First out of the airlock, every time. Sometimes before it has finished opening.

items.name: dreamy
items.desc: Often staring out of a window. Says they're thinking. They are, mostly about clouds.

items.name: tidy
items.desc: Labels everything. Has labelled the labels. Knows where every spoon is.

items.name: funny
items.desc: Can make anyone laugh, including people who were very busy being upset.

items.name: sleepy
items.desc: Can nap anywhere, at any angle, during any amount of noise.

items.name: always hungry
items.desc: Has a snack. Has another snack for later. Is thinking about a third snack.

items.name: talkative
items.desc: Will tell you about their day, your day, and several days that happened to other people.

items.name: quiet
items.desc: Says very little, notices everything, and leaves small useful things where you'll find them.

items.name: romantic
items.desc: Thinks every sunset is the best sunset. Is usually right.

items.name: stubborn
items.desc: Once they've decided something, the universe can either agree or wait.

items.name: collector
items.desc: Pockets full of pebbles, feathers, bolts and one button from every world.

items.name: superstitious
items.desc: Knocks on the hull for luck and never, ever whistles on a Tuesday.

items.name: brass observatory telescope
items.desc: Bolted to the observation deck, polished every week, pointed at whatever looks lonely.

items.name: record player and a crate of records
items.desc: Crackly songs from a dozen worlds. One of them skips, and everyone knows exactly where.

items.name: little garden in the hold
items.desc: Planters, a sun lamp and seeds from every world that let you take some.

items.name: reading nook
items.desc: A corner full of cushions, a lamp and a shelf of books that never stays tidy.

items.name: big cast-iron stove
items.desc: Heavy, black and always warm. It makes the galley the best room on the ship.

items.name: game table
items.desc: Cards, dice, a board game with half its pieces, and a strict rule about sore losers.

items.name: hammocks in the hold
items.desc: Strung between the cargo racks. The best naps on the ship happen here.
